messages.subject: unable to get gl.read.vcf to work
parts:
This was the command that didn't work:
gl.read.vcf(VCF_file, verbose = 1, installed =TRUE)

These were the package versions, which I think are up-to-date:
> packageVersion("dartR")
[1] ‘1.8.3’
> packageVersion("vcfR")
[1] ‘1.12.0’

Are there later versions or is something else wrong?
Thanks...Janice

parts:
Hi,

 

Sorry I did not explain that very well.

 

Unfortunately this function needed to be “commented” as CRAN does not allow to do any reference for deprecated packages. So the “trick” is to do the following

 

 

Simply type

 

gl.read.vcf

 

which in turn show the code of the commented function:

> gl.read.vcf

function(vcffile, verbose = 1, installed=FALSE) {

             

              x=NULL

              if (!installed) cat("This functions requires to have package vcfR installed, which is no longer on CRAN. Check ?gl.read.vcf for help.")

             

              #Change 'if (FALSE) {' below to 'if (TRUE) {' to run the function.

              # if (installed) {

              # if (!(requireNamespace("vcfR", quietly = TRUE))) {

              #   stop("To use this function you need to install package: vcfR. Please refer to the help of the function for instructions (?gl.read.vcf).")

              # } else { 

              # vcf <- vcfR::read.vcfR(file = vcffile, verbose = verbose)

              # x <- vcfR::vcfR2genlight(vcf)

              #

              # #add history

              # x@other$history <- list(match.call())

              # x <- gl.recalc.metrics(x)

              #

              # if (verbose) {

              #   cat(

              #     "genlight object does not have individual metrics. You need to add them 'manually' to the @other$ind.metrics slot.\n"

              #   )

              # }

              # return(x)

              # }

              # }

}

 

 

You need copy paste and uncomment each line in the source and then create a new file with this function. Source the function in to your r code and it should work. As mentioned there is not much I can do about it as long vcfR is no longer part of CRAN

 

 

To facilitate this, I did it for you, and will look for another way to distribute the file in the future.

 

So simply write:

 

source(“gl.read.vcf.R”)   #the function needs to be in the path here

 

at the beginning of your script and then use via:

 

gl <- gl.read.vcf(“yourvcffile”, installed=TRUE)
